description: D.D.M. Vitharana v. Vidanagamage Fransis and Another D.D.M. Vitharana v. Vidanagamage Fransis and Another View More before Hon. Sisira de Abrew J. and Hon. K.T. Chitrasiri J.
parties: D.D.M. Vitharana v. Vidanagamage Fransis and Another D.D.M. Vitharana v. Vidanagamage Fransis and Another View More
judgement_by: Hon. Sisira de Abrew J. and Hon. K.T. Chitrasiri J.
keywords: Appeal against a High Court order compelling the Commissioner of Agrarian Services to restore possession of a paddy field to an ande cultivator, following an earlier Court of Appeal decision quashing the cultivator\'s eviction. Held - the Commissioner had a public duty to implement the earlier judgement and restore possession; the appellant\'s prolonged unlawful possession could not stand. Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
